reviewed_helper_findings: fujp/lua_display.lua does not replace a Starbound API; it caches dictionaries and returns display values.
The guide/species helper additions are loaded by their respective scripted in-game panels, not by a newly introduced startup hook.
Guide/species helper lookups use finite tables and contain no while/repeat loop or self-requiring import.
No added recursive API wrapper or unbounded loop was identified in the v0.2.2 Lua delta.
Item-builder changes inspected are tooltip/description/name display values; gameplay/stat IDs remain in the original variables.

disposition.reason: No causal Lua/startup or world-generation control mutation was established. Preserve these reviewed files while the separately identified name-generation defects are corrected.
disposition.additional_possible_factor: Some name-related patches contain over 10,000 guard batches. Native first-load cost was not measured, so this remains a possible performance factor, not a diagnosis.
